promo.trust.title: Buugo adigoo si buuxda u xasilloon
promo.trust.subtitle: PALTAS wuxuu ilaaliyaa buugin kasta laga bilaabo raadinta ilaa gelitaanka.
promo.trust.payments.title: Lacag-bixin ammaan ah
promo.trust.payments.body: Lacag-bixin kastaa waxay maraysaa bixiyeyaal la aaminsan yahay oo la sireeyay — faahfaahinta kaarkaaga waligeed nagama kaydsana.
promo.trust.noFees.title: Weligeed khidmado qarsoon ma jiraan
promo.trust.noFees.body: Qiimaha aad aragto ayaa ah qiimaha aad bixinayso — nadaafadda, adeegga iyo canshuuraha dhammaantood horay ayaa loo muujiyaa.
promo.trust.checks.title: Hubin aad akhrisan karto
promo.trust.checks.body: Halkii aan ku xaqiijinnay aqoonsi, sanad lahaansho ama shati, liiskaas ayaa sidaas sheegaya oo sheegaya waxa la hubiyay. Halkii aynaan sidaas samayn, waxba ma sheegayo.
promo.travel.title: Xaggee xigta?
promo.travel.subtitle: Ogow meelaha ay socotadu jecel yihiin gobolka.
promo.early.title: Horay u buugo, kharash yar
promo.early.body: Guryaha ugu wanaagsan si degdeg ah ayaa loo buugtaa. Hadda buugo adigoo hela xaqiijin degdeg ah iyo lacag-bixin ammaan ah — fudud, degdeg ah, oo aan lahayn khidmado qarsoon.
promo.business.title: Ma dhisaysaa ama maamulaysaa hanti? Dhammaan ku samee PALTAS.
promo.business.body: Soo bandhig qolalkaaga, maamul kireystayaasha iyo kirada, la soco macaamiisha, ama iibi guryaha mashruucaaga — dhammaan hal shaashad, iyadoo lacag-bixin ammaan ah ku jirto.
promo.slide.hajj.headline: Deg meel lugta lagu gaari karo Xarunta Xurmaysan.
promo.slide.hajj.copy: Aqallo iyo hoteello loogu talagalay xujeyda iyo qoysaskooda, oo leh qiimo koox, saacado xasilloon waqtiyada salaadda, iyo martigeliyeyaal xilliga garanaya.
promo.slide.hajj.promise: Lacagtaada waa la hayaa ilaa aad gasho.
promo.slide.umrah.headline: Safar gaaban. Isla daryeelka meesha aad seexanayso.
promo.slide.umrah.copy: Buugo toddobaad ama wiiqaan Xarunta agteeda adigoon bixin qiimaha xilliga xajka. Joojin dabacsan, lacagtaaduna way hadhaysaa ilaa aad gasho.
promo.slide.umrah.promise: Wadarta aad aragto ayaa ah wadarta aad bixinayso.
promo.slide.marrakesh.headline: Riyaad ku dhex yaal medinada, ma aha hotel ka baxsan.
promo.slide.marrakesh.copy: Guryo barxad leh oo leh berkedo yaryar iyo barxado saqaf ah, daqiiqado ka fog Jemaa el-Fna. Martigeliyayaashu waxay diyaariyaan gaadiidka garoonka iyo xamaanka.
promo.slide.marrakesh.promise: Hubin kasta oo aan sameynay waa la muujiyaa, waxayna sheegaysaa waxa la baaray.
promo.slide.miami.headline: Ocean Drive dhinac, Atlantigana dhinaca kale.
promo.slide.miami.copy: Aqallo art-deco ah iyo kondooyin xeebeed oo ku yaal South Beach iyo Brickell, iyadoo qiimaha buuxa la muujiyo ka hor buuginta — khidmadaha hoyga oo dhan la mid ah.
promo.slide.miami.promise: Khidmad hoy kama soo bixi doonto tallaabada lacag-bixinta.
